programme.title: Spiritwalker [English Dub]

programme.title: The Swordsman [English Dub]

Will they be able to defeat the cult and save the girl from them?

programme.title: IP MAN 1 [English Dub]

Directed by Wilson Yip, the film stars Donnie Yen in the lead role, and features fight choreography by Sammo Hung.

programme.title: IP MAN 2 [English Dub]
programme.desc: Having defeated the best fighters of the Imperial Japanese army in occupied Shanghai, Ip Man and his family settle in post-war Hong Kong. Struggling to make a living, Master Ip opens a kung fu school to bring his celebrated art of Wing Chun to the troubled youth of Hong Kong. His growing reputation soon brings challenges from powerful enemies, including pre-eminent Hung Gar master, Hung Quan.

programme.title: BORN TO FLY [English Subtitle]

programme.title: The Wandering Earth 2 [English Dub]

programme.title: Victory [English Dub]
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story and a feel-great, rip-roaring romp about a group of high school girls who shake a sleepy town alive with pom-poms and perfectly synchronized cheerleading routines.

programme.title: To Be Killed by A High School Girl [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A man has an obsession that, if he is to die, it would be by being killed by a high school girl. With his strange obsession in mind, he decides to become a teacher.

programme.title: The Ugly [English Subtitle]

They interview people who worked with Jeong Yeong Hee at a Cheonggyecheon clothing factory about 40 years ago.

programme.title: Dirty Money [English Dub]

programme.title: BIG BROTHER [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A soldier-turned-high school teacher uses unusual methods to reach to a class of poor students, while dealing with a greedy entrepreneur and his gang of fighters as well as the government.

programme.title: Memoir of a Murderer [English Subtitle]
programme.desc: A former serial killer Byung-su gets diagnosed with Alzheimer’s. When a series of murders occur near his town, Byung-su gets worried whether the killings are his doings during his memory lapses. But then, he comes across Tae-ju and instinctively realizes that he's the serial killer. He reports this to the police, only to learn that Tae-ju is one. With his memory slipping, Byung-su must find a way to protect his daughter from Tae-ju.

programme.title: My Way [English Dub]

programme.title: Alienoid [English Dub]
